core.en: CORE IMAGE: a goal is pinned to the wall, and the person takes one more step toward it each day.
core.cn: 核心意象：墙上钉着一个目标，人每天朝它多走一步。

branches.en: THE DRIVE: the first sense is the force that keeps the walk going.
branches.cn: 动力线：第一个义项是让这段奔走持续的力量。

branches.en: THE DESTINATION: the second sense is the place the walk aims at.
branches.cn: 目的地线：第二个义项是这段奔走瞄准的地方。

branches.en: THE SHADOW: the third sense is the same walk seen as self-seeking.
branches.cn: 阴影线：第三个义项是同一段奔走被看作自私谋取。

branches.en: THE STEP: drive and aim need each other to become action.
branches.cn: 脚步线：动力与目标需要彼此才能变成行动。

branches.en: THE OFFICE: a post can be a noble aim or a private prize.
branches.cn: 职位线：一个职位既可以是高尚目标，也可以是私人战利品。

intro.en: Ambition is a Latin noun whose family grows with common adjective, adverb and noun suffixes.
intro.cn: ambition 是拉丁名词，词族由常见的形容词、副词与名词后缀生长出来。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ambi- and ire are the two pieces behind ambire and ambitio.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ambi- 与 ire 是 ambire 与 ambitio 背后的两个部件。

items.exampleCN: 他们雄心勃勃地扩大了计划。
他的进取心打动了教练。

items.example: The ambit of the law is broad.
items.exampleCN: 这项法律的适用范围很广。
政治抱负推动了这场竞选。

definition_zh: 救护车；急救车；救护队
definition_en: a vehicle used to carry sick or injured people to hospital, or the medical service that runs it
core_image: 一辆白色急救车闪着灯，穿过拥堵的街道
scene: 路口有人受伤，远处传来警笛声。An ambulance arrived within five minutes.
sceneCN: 这里 ambulance 是「救护车」（第 1 个义项：运送伤病者去医院的车辆）；句意为五分钟内就到了一辆救护车。

pos.zh: 名词：救护车；急救车；救护队

derivatives.zh: 同源形容词，义为「能走动的；不必卧床的」
同源形容词，义为「可走动的；门诊的」
同源动词，义为「行走；移动」，多见于医学语境

senses.title: The emergency vehicle
senses.definition: a vehicle equipped to carry and treat people who are seriously ill or injured
senses.definitionCN: 装备用来运送并救治重病或受伤者的车辆
senses.example: The ambulance took the injured cyclist to hospital.
senses.exampleCN: 救护车把受伤的骑车人送到医院。
senses.why: French hôpital ambulant meant a 'walking hospital'; the vehicle is a hospital that moves to the patient.
senses.whyCN: 法语 hôpital ambulant 意为「会走路的医院」；这种车就是开到病人身边的医院。

senses.title: The emergency service
senses.definition: the organized service, crew, or system that responds to medical emergencies
senses.definitionCN: 应对医疗紧急情况的有组织服务、队伍或体系
senses.example: The ambulance was delayed by heavy snow.
senses.exampleCN: 急救服务被大雪耽搁了。
senses.why: The vehicle stands for the people and the system behind it, so calling an ambulance calls the whole service.
senses.whyCN: 车辆代表了它背后的人与体系，因此叫一辆救护车，就是叫整套急救服务。

intro.en: Ambulance began as a walking hospital, and the Latin verb for walking is still visible inside it.
intro.cn: ambulance 最初是「会走路的医院」，表示「行走」的拉丁动词至今仍藏在词里。

items.en: Ambulare meant 'to walk', the source of ambulate and ambulatory.
items.cn: ambulare 意为「行走」，是 ambulate 与 ambulatory 的来源。

items.en: The phrase hôpital ambulant named a mobile field hospital that moved with an army.
items.cn: 短语 hôpital ambulant 指随军移动的流动野战医院。

items.en: French shortened the phrase to ambulance, the moving hospital itself.
items.cn: 法语把短语缩为 ambulance，指这座会移动的医院本身。

items.en: The word spread in English during the nineteenth century through military medical reports.
items.cn: 这个词在十九世纪通过军医报告在英语中传播开来。

items.en: English ambulance first meant a mobile hospital and later the vehicle that carries patients.
items.cn: 英语 ambulance 先指流动医院，后指运送病人的车辆。

items.en: The word now covers the vehicle, its crew and the emergency service as a whole.
items.cn: 这个词如今覆盖车辆、车组人员以及整个急救服务。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin walking family; the near-meaning group gathers emergency medical words.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁「行走」词族；近义组收急救医疗类词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning able to walk or related to walking patients.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「能走动的」或「与可走动病人有关的」。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning not confined to bed.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不必卧床的」。

entries.definition: A verb meaning to walk or move about.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「行走；移动」。

entries.definition: Any vehicle used to answer an emergency.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何用于应对紧急情况的车辆。

entries.definition: A trained medical worker who arrives by ambulance.
entries.definitionCN: 指随救护车赶到的受训医务人员。

entries.definition: A frame for carrying a sick or injured person.
entries.definitionCN: 指运送伤病者的担架。

entries.definition: The general term for moving patients.
entries.definitionCN: 指运送病人的统称。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep the idea of a hospital that walks to the patient.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子保留「医院走到病人身边」这一想法。

normal.en: Ambulance hides ambulare, to walk: a hospital on wheels.
normal.cn: ambulance 里藏着 ambulare，意为走：一座长轮子的医院。

normal.en: The old phrase was walking hospital, and the vehicle still walks.
normal.cn: 旧短语是「会走路的医院」，这种车至今仍在走。

normal.en: Call an ambulance and you call both the car and its crew.
normal.cn: 叫救护车，既是叫车，也是叫车上的人。

normal.en: The siren clears the road so the walking hospital can arrive.
normal.cn: 警笛清开道路，让这座会走路的医院赶到。

normal.en: Ambulatory patients can walk; ambulance patients cannot.
normal.cn: ambulatory 的病人能走；ambulance 里的病人不能。

abstract.en: Picture a field tent that folds up and moves with an army.
abstract.cn: 想象一顶能收起来随军移动的野战帐篷。

abstract.en: Now picture that tent replaced by a white van with flashing lights.
abstract.cn: 再想象那顶帐篷换成一辆闪灯的白色厢车。

abstract.en: The van still carries the tent's old name: the walking hospital.
abstract.cn: 这辆厢车仍带着帐篷的旧名：会走路的医院。

examples.en: Call an ambulance at once; he cannot breathe.
examples.cn: 马上叫救护车，他不能呼吸了。

examples.en: The ambulance crew carried the child gently onto the stretcher.
examples.cn: 急救人员轻轻把孩子抬上担架。

examples.en: She was taken to the clinic by ambulance.
examples.cn: 她被救护车送到诊所。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「俺不能死」——俺不能死，快叫救护车

root: 拉丁语 ambulare（行走）+ -ance（名词后缀），经法语 hôpital ambulant（流动医院）缩为 ambulance；核心是「会移动的医院」。

sensesIntro.en: The two senses are the moving hospital itself and the service that sends it.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项分别是会移动的医院本身，以及派出它的急救服务。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a white van with flashing lights crosses a crowded street toward someone in need.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆闪灯的白色厢车穿过拥挤街道，奔向需要帮助的人。

branches.en: THE VEHICLE: the first sense is the moving hospital on wheels.
branches.cn: 车辆线：第一个义项是长轮子的流动医院。

branches.en: THE SERVICE: the second sense is the crew and system behind the vehicle.
branches.cn: 服务线：第二个义项是车辆背后的人员与体系。

branches.en: THE CALL: asking for an ambulance means asking for both car and crew.
branches.cn: 呼叫线：叫救护车意味着同时叫车与人。

branches.en: THE SIREN: the vehicle's urgency is heard before it is seen.
branches.cn: 警笛线：车辆的紧急先被听见，再被看见。

branches.en: THE WALK: the Latin root survives in the staff who walk patients to care.
branches.cn: 行走线：拉丁词根活在把病人送进救治的人员身上。

intro.en: Ambulance is a French shortening of a Latin phrase, and its family is built on the verb for walking.
intro.cn: ambulance 是拉丁短语的法语缩略，词族建立在表示「行走」的动词上。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ambulare is the walking verb behind the whole family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ambulare 是整个词族背后的「行走」动词。

items.example: The ambulance service covers the whole county.
He was brought in by ambulance.

definition_zh: 在……之中；在……中间；在……群体内；在……之间分配
definition_en: in the middle of a group, or shared between members of a group
core_image: 一个人坐在人群中间，四周都是同伴
scene: 一群学生坐在树下，她坐在他们中间。She sat among a group of students under the tree.
sceneCN: 这里 among 是「在……之中」（第 1 个义项：处在某个群体的中间）；句意为她坐在树下的一群学生中间。

pos.zh: 介词：在……之中；在……中间；在……之间

derivatives.zh: among 的变体形式，义同「在……之中」，多见于英式英语
同源动词，义为「混合；交往」，与 among 共享「混杂」的古义

senses.title: Surrounded by a group
senses.definition: in the middle of a number of people or things that surround one
senses.definitionCN: 处在把某人或某物围住的若干人或物中间
senses.example: The little house stood among tall trees.
senses.exampleCN: 那座小房子立在高大的树木中间。
senses.why: Old English on gemang meant 'in the mingling, in the crowd', and the crowd is exactly what surrounds a person.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 on gemang 意为「在混杂之中、在人群里」，而人群正是把一个人围住的东西。

senses.title: As one of a group
senses.definition: belonging to or included in a group, class, or number
senses.definitionCN: 属于或被包含在一个群体、类别或数目之中
senses.example: He is among the best swimmers in the country.
senses.exampleCN: 他是全国最好的游泳者之一。
senses.why: To be in the mingling is also to be counted as one of it, so among marks membership as well as position.
senses.whyCN: 处在混杂之中，也就是被算作其中一员，因此 among 既标记位置，也标记成员身份。

senses.title: Shared between members
senses.definition: used when something is divided or shared by several people or groups
senses.definitionCN: 用于某物被若干人或群体分开或共享的情形
senses.example: The money was divided among the four sisters.
senses.exampleCN: 这笔钱在四个姐妹之间分了。
senses.why: The crowd becomes a set of receivers: what is placed in the middle is distributed to each member.
senses.whyCN: 人群变成一组接受者：放在中间的东西被分给每个成员。

intro.en: Among began as a phrase about being in the mingling, and its senses still place something inside a group.
intro.cn: among 最初是一个表示「处在混杂之中」的短语，它的义项至今仍把某物放进一个群体。

items.en: Gemang meant 'a mingling, a crowd', from a verb meaning to mix.
items.cn: gemang 意为「混杂、人群」，来自表示「混合」的动词。

items.en: The phrase on gemang meant 'in the crowd, among them'.
items.cn: 短语 on gemang 意为「在人群中、在他们中间」。

items.en: The phrase contracted into the single preposition among.
items.cn: 这个短语缩合成单个介词 among。

items.en: Among is recorded from the thirteenth century in both position and membership senses.
items.cn: among 自十三世纪有记录，位置义与成员义都已出现。

items.en: The idea of a crowd extended to sharing: a thing placed among a group is divided among its members.
items.cn: 人群的概念扩展到共享：放进一群之中的东西，被分给其中成员。

items.en: Among and amongst survive side by side, with amongst more common in British writing.
items.cn: among 与 amongst 并存，其中 amongst 在英式书面语中更常见。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the variant and the mixing root; the near-meaning group gathers position and distribution prepositions.
note.cn: 形近组收变体与「混合」词根；近义组收位置与分配类介词。

entries.definition: A variant of among, common in British English.
entries.definitionCN: among 的变体，在英式英语中常见。

entries.definition: To mix with others in a group.
entries.definitionCN: 指在群体中与他人交往混合。

entries.definition: The act of mixing socially.
entries.definitionCN: 指社交上的混合交往。

entries.definition: In the middle of, often of surroundings or events.
entries.definitionCN: 指在……之中，多用于环境或事件。

entries.definition: A variant of amid, more literary.
entries.definitionCN: amid 的变体，更具文学色彩。

entries.definition: In the space separating two or more distinct things.
entries.definitionCN: 指在两个或更多彼此分开的事物之间。

entries.definition: At the central point of something.
entries.definitionCN: 指在某物的中心位置。

normalIntro.en: These hooks put a person inside a crowd, then let the crowd become a set of receivers.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子先把一个人放进人群，再让人群变成一组接受者。

normal.en: Among comes from a word for mingling: to be among is to be in the mix.
normal.cn: among 来自表示「混合」的词：处在 among 之中，就是处在混杂里。

normal.en: If you are surrounded by the group, you are among it.
normal.cn: 如果你被这个群体围住，你就在它之中。

normal.en: If you count as one of the group, you are also among it.
normal.cn: 如果你被算作群体一员，你也在它之中。

normal.en: Divide among the four means the middle becomes four shares.
normal.cn: divide among the four 意为中间的东西变成四份。

normal.en: Among is for a crowd; between is for separate points.
normal.cn: among 用于人群；between 用于彼此分开的点。

abstract.en: Picture a circle of people with one empty seat in the centre.
abstract.cn: 想象一圈人，中间留着一个空位。

abstract.en: Now picture someone sitting in that seat and the circle closing.
abstract.cn: 再想象有人坐进那个位置，圆圈合拢。

abstract.en: The closing circle is among: inside, counted, shared.
abstract.cn: 合拢的圆圈就是 among：在里面、被算入、被分享。

examples.en: She found her keys among the papers on the desk.
examples.cn: 她在桌上的文件堆里找到了钥匙。

examples.en: Among the guests was an old friend of mine.
examples.cn: 客人中有我的一位老朋友。

examples.en: The land was divided among the three brothers.
examples.cn: 这块地在三个兄弟之间分了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿蒙」——阿蒙，蒙在人群中间，四周都是人

root: 古英语 on gemang（在混杂之中、在人群里），gemang 意为「混杂、人群」；缩合为 among，核心是「处在群体内部」，并引申出「属于其中」与「在成员间分配」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses all place something inside a group: surrounded by it, counted in it, or shared out within it.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项都把某物放进一个群体：被它围住、被算入其中，或在其中被分掉。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a person sits in the middle of a circle of companions.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个人坐在一圈同伴的中间。

branches.en: THE CIRCLE: the first sense is being surrounded by the group.
branches.cn: 圆圈线：第一个义项是被群体围住。

branches.en: THE MEMBER: the second sense is being one of the group.
branches.cn: 成员线：第二个义项是成为群体中的一员。

branches.en: THE SHARE: the third sense turns the group into receivers.
branches.cn: 份额线：第三个义项把群体变成接受者。

branches.en: THE INSIDE: position and membership are two sides of the same circle.
branches.cn: 内部线：位置与成员身份是同一个圆圈的两面。

branches.en: THE SET: counted members are the ones who can receive a share.
branches.cn: 集合线：被算入的成员才有资格分得一份。

intro.en: Among is a fused preposition, so its list gathers its variant, its root and its common frames.
intro.cn: among 是融合的介词，条目收集它的变体、词根与常用框架。

latinIntro.en: The word is native English, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属于本土英语，因此拉丁条目为空。

items.meaning: in the middle of a group

items.example: Amongst the crowd stood a child.
items.exampleCN: 人群之中站着一个孩子。

items.meaning: as well as other people or things

items.exampleCN: 她在朋友中间感到安全。

items.example: The food was divided among the children.

definition_zh: 数量；总额；金额；总计；等于
definition_en: a quantity or total, or to add up to or be equivalent to something
core_image: 账单上的数字一行行往上累，最后堆成一个总数
scene: 账单上的数字一行行累加，最后落到一个总数。The amount on the bill was more than we expected.
sceneCN: 这里 amount 是「金额；总额」（第 1 个义项：数量或总计的钱数）；句意为账单上的金额比我们预想的多。

pos.zh: 名词：数量；总额；金额
不及物动词：总计；等于

derivatives.zh: 同源动词，义为「登上；增加」，amount 的前身即由它加前缀构成
同源词，由 sur-（在上）+ mount 构成，义为「克服；越过」
同源词，义为「无法克服的」

senses.title: A quantity or total
senses.definition: how much of something there is, especially a sum of money or a measured quantity
senses.definitionCN: 某物有多少，尤指一笔钱数或测得的分量
senses.example: The amount of water in the tank is falling.
senses.exampleCN: 水箱里的水量正在下降。
senses.why: Old French amonter meant 'to go up'; a column of figures going up ends in a total, and that total is the amount.
senses.whyCN: 古法语 amonter 意为「向上走」；一列数字往上走，最后得到一个总数，这个总数就是 amount。

senses.title: To add up to a total
senses.definition: to reach a particular total when all parts are counted
senses.definitionCN: 把各部分加起来时达到某个特定总数
senses.example: The bills amount to more than a month's salary.
senses.exampleCN: 这些账单合计起来超过一个月工资。
senses.why: The verb keeps the climbing column: the parts rise until they stand at one figure.
senses.whyCN: 动词保留着往上爬的那一列：各部分不断升高，直到站在同一个数字上。

senses.title: To be equivalent to
senses.definition: to be equal in effect or importance to something else
senses.definitionCN: 在效果或重要性上等同于另一事物
senses.example: His silence amounted to an admission of guilt.
senses.exampleCN: 他的沉默等于承认了罪责。
senses.why: If two things come up to the same level, one amounts to the other; value, not just number, can be totalled.
senses.whyCN: 如果两样东西升到同一高度，一个就等同于另一个；可以合计的不只是数字，还有价值。

intro.en: Amount began as a verb for going up a mountain, and its figures still climb into a total.
intro.cn: amount 最初是表示「上山」的动词，它的数字至今仍向上爬成一个总数。

items.en: The phrase ad montem meant 'to the mountain', literally upward.
items.cn: 短语 ad montem 意为「到山那里」，字面就是向上。

items.en: Amonter meant 'to go up, rise', and it came to describe sums piling up.
items.cn: amonter 意为「上升、升高」，后来用来描述累加起来的数目。

items.en: English amount first appeared as a verb meaning to rise or add up.
items.cn: 英语 amount 最初作为动词出现，意为上升或合计。

items.en: The noun amount named the total that the climbing figures reached.
items.cn: 名词 amount 指那些上升的数字最终达到的总数。

items.en: Amount to widened from a numerical total to any kind of equivalent effect.
items.cn: amount to 从数字总数扩展到任何等价的效果。

items.en: Modern English uses amount mainly for uncountable quantities and sums of money.
items.cn: 现代英语中 amount 主要用于不可数数量与钱款总额。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the mountain-root family; the near-meaning group gathers quantity and total words.
note.cn: 形近组收「山」词根词族；近义组收数量与总数类词。

entries.definition: To climb up, or to increase gradually.
entries.definitionCN: 指登上，或逐渐增加。

entries.definition: To overcome an obstacle or rise above it.
entries.definitionCN: 指克服障碍或凌驾其上。

entries.definition: Supreme in importance, from a phrase meaning above the mountain.
entries.definitionCN: 指最重要的，源自意为「山之上」的短语。

entries.definition: How much there is of something measurable.
entries.definitionCN: 指可测量事物的多少。

entries.definition: A total of money or numbers.
entries.definitionCN: 指钱数或数字的总和。

entries.definition: The whole sum after adding everything.
entries.definitionCN: 指全部加起来的整体数字。

entries.definition: A number or amount written down.
entries.definitionCN: 指写下的一项数字或金额。

normalIntro.en: These hooks keep a column of figures climbing upward until it reaches one total.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子保留一列向上爬的数字，直到它们到达同一个总数。

normal.en: Amount hides a-mount, to climb up: the figures climb into a total.
normal.cn: amount 里藏着 a-mount，意为向上登：数字爬上同一个总数。

normal.en: A bill is a mountain of small charges, and the amount is the summit.
normal.cn: 账单是一座由小额费用堆成的山，amount 就是山顶。

normal.en: Amount to means the parts reach one figure.
normal.cn: amount to 意为各部分到达同一个数字。

normal.en: Silence can amount to guilt: effects can be totalled too.
normal.cn: 沉默可以 amount to 罪责：效果也能被合计。

normal.en: Amount is for uncountable stuff; number is for countable things.
normal.cn: amount 用于不可数事物；number 用于可数事物。

abstract.en: Picture a mountainside marked with prices instead of metres.
abstract.cn: 想象一面山坡，标尺上写的不是米数，而是价格。

abstract.en: Now picture a hiker stopping at the summit and reading the last figure.
abstract.cn: 再想象登山者停在顶上，读出最后一个数字。

abstract.en: That last figure is the amount: the height of the pile.
abstract.cn: 最后那个数字就是 amount：这一堆的高度。

examples.en: Add the amount of salt shown on the packet.
examples.cn: 按包装上标明的量加盐。

examples.en: The repairs amounted to half the value of the car.
examples.cn: 修理费合计达到车价的一半。

examples.en: His refusal amounted to a rejection of the offer.
examples.cn: 他的拒绝等于对这项提议的回绝。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿芒特」——阿，芒特，数字堆成一座山，顶上是总数

root: 拉丁语 ad montem（到山那里）→ 古法语 amonter（上升）→ 英语 amount；由「数字向上累加」引申为「总数」及动词「总计、等于」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses follow one rising column: the total it reaches, the act of adding up, and the point where two things are equal.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项沿着同一列上升的数字：它到达的总数、累加的行为，以及两物等高的那一点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: figures stack upward like a slope until the last one marks the summit.
core.cn: 核心意象：数字像斜坡一样向上堆叠，最后一个标出山顶。

branches.en: THE SUMMIT: the first sense is the total at the top of the pile.
branches.cn: 山顶线：第一个义项是这一堆顶端的数字。

branches.en: THE CLIMB: the second sense is the act of adding parts up.
branches.cn: 攀登线：第二个义项是把各部分加起来的行为。

branches.en: THE LEVEL: the third sense is two different things reaching one height.
branches.cn: 水平线：第三个义项是两样不同的东西达到同一高度。

branches.en: THE COLUMN: a total and its adding are the same column seen from two ends.
branches.cn: 数字列：总数与累加是同一列数字从两端看。

branches.en: THE VALUE: what is counted can also be weighed as worth.
branches.cn: 价值线：被计算的东西也可以被衡量的价值。

intro.en: Amount is a French verb turned noun, and its family keeps the image of mounting upward.
intro.cn: amount 是由法语动词转成的名词，词族保留「向上登」的意象。

latinIntro.en: The Latin mons, 'mountain', is the distant base behind mount and amount.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 mons（山）是 mount 与 amount 背后的远源词基。

items.meaning: to total or be equivalent to
items.example: The cost amounts to a fortune.
A large amount of data was lost.
A small amount of money was enough.

definition_zh: 充足的；富裕的；宽敞的；丰满的
definition_en: more than enough in quantity or size, or spacious and roomy
core_image: 一只大篮子，里面装的东西还空着一半
scene: 仓库堆满货箱，取用空间还有很多。There is ample room for everyone to sit.
sceneCN: 这里 ample 是「充足的」（第 1 个义项：数量上足够甚至有余）；句意为有足够的空间让每个人坐下。

pos.zh: 形容词：充足的；富裕的；宽敞的；丰满的

derivatives.zh: 由 ample 加 -ly 构成，义为「充分地；绰绰有余地」
同源名词，义为「幅度；振幅；广阔」
同源动词，义为「放大；增强；详述」
由 amplify 加 -ication 构成，义为「放大；扩充」
由 amplify 加 -er 构成，义为「放大器」

senses.title: More than enough
senses.definition: enough or more than enough for a particular need
senses.definitionCN: 对某项需要来说足够甚至有余
senses.example: There is ample time to finish the work before dark.
senses.exampleCN: 天黑前有充足的时间完成这项工作。
senses.why: Latin amplus meant 'large, spacious'; a large container holds more than the need, and the word became 'more than enough'.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 amplus 意为「大的、宽敞的」；一个大的容器装得比所需更多，于是这个词变成「绰绰有余」。

senses.title: Spacious and roomy
senses.definition: large in size or area, with plenty of space
senses.definitionCN: 面积或体积大，空间充裕
senses.example: The house has an ample garden behind it.
senses.exampleCN: 这所房子后面有一座宽敞的花园。
senses.why: The physical sense is the oldest: ample space is simply space that is large enough to move in freely.
senses.whyCN: 物理义最古老：ample 的空间就是大到可以自由走动的空间。

senses.title: Generously full in shape
senses.definition: used of a body or garment that is large and generously proportioned
senses.definitionCN: 形容身体或衣物宽大、比例丰盈
senses.example: The coat was cut in an ample style that suited him.
senses.exampleCN: 这件外套剪裁宽大，很适合他。
senses.why: If large size can describe space, it can also describe a body or a garment that fills that space generously.
senses.whyCN: 如果「大」可以形容空间，它也可以形容一个宽裕地占满空间的身体或衣物。

intro.en: Ample comes from a Latin adjective for largeness, and the whole family is about making something bigger.
intro.cn: ample 来自拉丁语中表示「大」的形容词，整个词族都与「使变大」有关。

items.en: Amplus meant 'large, spacious, abundant', and it also gave amplus-based words such as amplitude.
items.cn: amplus 意为「大的、宽敞的、丰富的」，还给出了 amplitude 等词。

items.en: Amplificare meant 'to enlarge, widen', the verb behind amplify.
items.cn: amplificare 意为「扩大、加宽」，是 amplify 背后的动词。

items.en: French ample carried the adjective into English with the sense of plentiful and roomy.
items.cn: 法语 ample 把这个形容词带入英语，含义是充足与宽敞。

items.en: English ample is recorded in the fifteenth century for space and for quantity.
items.cn: 英语 ample 在十五世纪有记录，既用于空间，也用于数量。

items.en: The word now covers time, evidence, opportunity and generous proportions.
items.cn: 这个词如今覆盖时间、证据、机会以及宽大的体型。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the Latin largeness family; the near-meaning group gathers sufficiency words.
note.cn: 形近组收拉丁「大」词族；近义组收「充足」类词。

entries.definition: To make sound, signal, or an account larger.
entries.definitionCN: 指放大声音、信号或把叙述扩充。

entries.definition: The size of a wave's swing or the breadth of something.
entries.definitionCN: 指波摆动的幅度或某物的广阔。

entries.definition: In a more than sufficient way.
entries.definitionCN: 指以绰绰有余的方式。

entries.definition: Existing in large amounts.
entries.definitionCN: 指大量存在的。

entries.definition: Just enough for a purpose, with no surplus.
entries.definitionCN: 指刚好够用，没有剩余。

entries.definition: Having a lot of room inside.
entries.definitionCN: 指内部空间很大。

entries.definition: Larger or more giving than expected.
entries.definitionCN: 指比预期更大或更慷慨。

normalIntro.en: These hooks start with a large basket that still has room, then move the largeness to time and shape.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从一只还有空余的大篮子开始，再把「大」移到时间与体形上。

normal.en: Ample is a big basket: what you need fits with room to spare.
normal.cn: ample 就是一只大篮子：所需的东西装得下，还留有余地。

normal.en: Ample time means the day is a big basket.
normal.cn: ample time 意为这一整天就是一只大篮子。

normal.en: Ample room means the walls are far apart.
normal.cn: ample room 意为墙与墙隔得很远。

normal.en: Amply means with plenty left over.
normal.cn: amply 意为还剩下许多。

normal.en: Amplify makes the same largeness audible.
normal.cn: amplify 让同一种「大」变得可听见。

abstract.en: Picture a market basket filled only halfway.
abstract.cn: 想象一只只装了一半的菜篮。

abstract.en: Now picture the empty half becoming hours on a clock.
abstract.cn: 再想象空着的那一半变成钟上的小时。

abstract.en: The spare half is ample, in space or in time.
abstract.cn: 空出的那一半就是 ample，无论在空间还是时间上。

examples.en: We had ample warning before the storm arrived.
examples.cn: 暴风雨来临前，我们得到了充分的警告。

examples.en: The hall is ample enough for two hundred people.
examples.cn: 这个大厅宽敞得足以容纳两百人。

examples.en: The report offers ample evidence for its claim.
examples.cn: 这份报告为其主张提供了充分的证据。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安普尔」——安，普尔，篮子大得装不满，绰绰有余

root: 拉丁语 amplus（大的、宽敞的、丰富的），经法语 ample 进入英语；核心是「容量大于所需」，由空间义扩展出「充足」与「宽大」义。

sensesIntro.en: The senses share one large container: enough and to spare, wide open space, and a body that fills space generously.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项共享同一个大容器：够用且有余、开阔的空间，以及宽裕地占满空间的身体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a large basket is only half full, with plenty of room left.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只大篮子只装了一半，还留着许多空间。

branches.en: THE SURPLUS: the first sense is capacity beyond the need.
branches.cn: 余量线：第一个义项是超出需要的容量。

branches.en: THE ROOM: the second sense is physical space that is wide open.
branches.cn: 空间线：第二个义项是开阔的物理空间。

branches.en: THE BODY: the third sense applies largeness to shape and clothing.
branches.cn: 体形线：第三个义项把「大」用于体形与衣物。

branches.en: THE BASKET: quantity and space are both measured by capacity.
branches.cn: 篮子线：数量与空间都靠容量来衡量。

branches.en: THE PROPORTION: wide space and full shape share the same generosity.
branches.cn: 比例线：开阔的空间与丰满的体形共享同一种宽裕。

intro.en: Ample is a Latin adjective with a productive family of adverbs, nouns and verbs.
intro.cn: ample 是拉丁形容词，拥有能产的副词、名词与动词词族。

latinIntro.en: The Latin amplus and the verb amplificare stand behind the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 amplus 与动词 amplificare 站在词族背后。

items.example: The wave has a large amplitude.

items.meaning: a device that strengthens a signal

items.example: There is ample room in the hall.

definition_zh: 逗乐；使开心；给……提供消遣
definition_en: to entertain someone or make them laugh, especially lightly
core_image: 一个简单的把戏，让紧绷的脸松开笑
scene: 候车室里孩子坐不住，父亲掏出纸笔折了个小玩意。The clown amused the children with simple tricks.
sceneCN: 这里 amuse 是「逗乐；使开心」（第 1 个义项：让人感到有趣、发笑）；句意为小丑用简单的把戏逗孩子们开心。

pos.zh: 及物动词：逗乐；使开心；给……提供消遣

derivatives.zh: 由 amuse 加 -ed 构成，义为「被逗乐的；觉得好笑的」
由 amuse 加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的；逗人笑的」
由 amusing 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣地；逗人笑地」
由 amuse 加 -ment 构成，义为「乐趣；娱乐活动」

senses.title: To entertain someone
senses.definition: to give someone something pleasant to do or watch, so that time passes happily
senses.definitionCN: 给某人愉快的事情去做或观看，让时间愉快地过去
senses.example: The museum has games that amuse young visitors.
senses.exampleCN: 博物馆有一些让年轻参观者消遣的游戏。
senses.why: French amuser first meant to occupy the attention, even to divert it; entertainment is attention kept pleasantly busy.
senses.whyCN: 法语 amuser 最初意为「占据注意力」，甚至「使转移」；娱乐就是让注意力愉快地忙着。

senses.title: To make someone laugh
senses.definition: to cause someone to smile or laugh with something funny
senses.definitionCN: 用有趣的事物使某人微笑或大笑
senses.example: His story about the lost parrot amused the whole table.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲丢失鹦鹉的故事，逗乐了整桌人。
senses.why: When the pleasant occupation tips into laughter, the same verb names the joke that loosens the face.
senses.whyCN: 当愉快的占据滑向大笑时，同一个动词就命名了那个让脸放松的笑话。

senses.title: To keep oneself pleasantly busy
senses.definition: in the phrase amuse oneself, to find pleasant occupation without needing others
senses.definitionCN: 用于短语 amuse oneself，指不需要他人而给自己找到愉快的消遣
senses.example: She amused herself with a puzzle while waiting.
senses.exampleCN: 等待时她用拼图自娱。
senses.why: The attention can be occupied from inside as well as outside, so the verb turns reflexive and names self-entertainment.
senses.whyCN: 注意力既可以由外界占据，也可以由自己占据，因此这个动词可以反身，命名自我娱乐。

intro.en: Amuse began as a word for occupying the attention, and its family still hides the old verb to muse.
intro.cn: amuse 最初指占据注意力，它的词族里至今藏着古老的动词 muse。

items.en: Muser meant 'to stare, to ponder', to let the mind dwell on something.
items.cn: muser 意为「凝视、沉思」，让心思停留在某事上。

items.en: Amuser added the prefix a- and meant 'to occupy or divert the attention'.
items.cn: amuser 加上前缀 a-，意为「占据或转移注意力」。

items.en: English amuse entered in the fifteenth century with the sense of diverting someone.
items.cn: 英语 amuse 于十五世纪进入，含义是转移某人的注意力。

items.en: The word softened from diversion to pleasant entertainment.
items.cn: 词义从「转移」软化为「愉快的娱乐」。

items.en: By the modern period amuse commonly meant to make someone laugh.
items.cn: 到现代时期，amuse 通常指「使某人发笑」。

items.en: Amusing and amused split the active and passive sides of the same verb.
items.cn: amusing 与 amused 把同一个动词的主动与被动两面分开。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the muse root and derived forms; the near-meaning group gathers lighter entertainment verbs.
note.cn: 形近组收 muse 词根与派生形式；近义组收较轻的「娱乐」动词。

entries.definition: To think quietly about something.
entries.definitionCN: 指安静地思考某事。

entries.definition: Funny and lightly entertaining.
entries.definitionCN: 指有趣的、轻松逗笑的。

entries.definition: Pleasure or entertainment.
entries.definitionCN: 指乐趣或娱乐。

entries.definition: To hold someone's attention pleasantly.
entries.definitionCN: 指愉快地吸引某人的注意力。

entries.definition: To give great pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 指给予很大的快乐。

entries.definition: To draw attention away, a stronger diversion.
entries.definitionCN: 指把注意力引开，转移意味更强。

entries.definition: To please by personality or appeal.
entries.definitionCN: 指以个性或魅力取悦人。

normalIntro.en: These hooks begin with attention being occupied and end with a face relaxing into laughter.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从注意力被占据开始，到一张脸放松并笑出来结束。

normal.en: Amuse hides muse: first the mind is occupied, then it smiles.
normal.cn: amuse 里藏着 muse：头脑先被占据，然后露出微笑。

normal.en: A game amuses by giving the eyes something pleasant to follow.
normal.cn: 游戏通过给眼睛愉快的东西可看来逗人。

normal.en: A joke amuses by loosening the face.
normal.cn: 笑话通过让脸放松来逗乐。

normal.en: Amuse yourself means you occupy your own attention.
normal.cn: amuse yourself 意为你自己占据自己的注意力。

normal.en: Amused is the listener; amusing is the storyteller.
normal.cn: amused 是听者；amusing 是讲故事的人。

abstract.en: Picture a bored child tapping a window in a waiting room.
abstract.cn: 想象候车室里一个无聊的孩子敲着窗户。

abstract.en: Now picture a folded paper bird landing in the child's hand.
abstract.cn: 再想象一只折纸鸟落到孩子手里。

abstract.en: The paper bird is amuse: attention captured, face opened.
abstract.cn: 那只纸鸟就是 amuse：注意力被抓住，脸打开了。

examples.en: The little dog amused everyone at the party.
examples.cn: 那只小狗逗乐了聚会上的每个人。

examples.en: He told a joke to amuse the waiting passengers.
examples.cn: 他讲了个笑话逗等候的乘客开心。

examples.en: The children amused themselves with stones by the river.
examples.cn: 孩子们在河边用石头自娱自乐。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿缪兹」——阿，缪兹，一逗，大家都乐了

root: 法语 a-（使）+ muser（凝视、沉思），原意为「占据或转移注意力」，十五世纪进入英语；由「消遣」发展为「逗乐、使发笑」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses follow attention: occupied pleasantly, tipped into laughter, or occupied by oneself.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项沿着注意力展开：被愉快地占据、滑向大笑，或由自己占据。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a tense face loosens into a smile at a small trick.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张紧绷的脸因一个小把戏松成微笑。

branches.en: THE OCCUPATION: the first sense keeps attention pleasantly busy.
branches.cn: 占据线：第一个义项让注意力愉快地忙着。

branches.en: THE LAUGH: the second sense turns the occupation into comedy.
branches.cn: 笑声线：第二个义项把这种占据变成喜剧。

branches.en: THE SELF: the third sense lets the person occupy their own attention.
branches.cn: 自我线：第三个义项让人占据自己的注意力。

branches.en: THE FACE: entertainment and laughter are two degrees of the same loosening.
branches.cn: 面部线：娱乐与大笑是同一种放松的两个程度。

branches.en: THE SOURCE: attention can be captured from outside or from inside.
branches.cn: 来源线：注意力可以从外部或内部被抓住。

intro.en: Amuse is a French borrowing with a modern family of participial adjectives and a noun.
intro.cn: amuse 是法语借词，拥有现代的分词形容词与名词词族。

latinIntro.en: The word reached English through French, so no direct Latin entry is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经法语进入英语，因此不列直接拉丁条目。

items.exampleCN: 这台机器失败得很有趣。

items.example: The game gave us hours of amusement.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏给了我们几小时的乐趣。

items.example: We were amused by her joke.
items.exampleCN: 我们被她的笑话逗乐了。

definition_zh: 乐趣；娱乐；消遣活动；游乐设施
definition_en: the feeling of finding something funny, or an activity or place that entertains people
core_image: 旋转木马转起来，人群的笑声跟着起伏
scene: 游乐园里旋转木马转个不停，孩子笑出声。The amusement park stayed open until midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 amusement 是「娱乐；游乐」（第 2 个义项：供人消遣娱乐的活动或场所）；句意为这座游乐园一直开到午夜。

pos.zh: 名词：乐趣；娱乐；消遣活动；游乐设施

derivatives.zh: 基础动词，义为「逗乐；给……提供消遣」
由 amuse 加 -ed 构成，义为「被逗乐的」
由 amuse 加 -ing 构成，义为「有趣的」
由 amusing 加 -ly 构成，义为「有趣地」

senses.title: The feeling of finding something funny
senses.definition: the pleasant feeling caused by something funny or lightly entertaining
senses.definitionCN: 由有趣或轻松娱乐的事物引起的愉快感受
senses.example: She watched the argument with quiet amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 她饶有兴致地安静看着这场争论。
senses.why: The noun adds -ment to the verb amuse: the state left behind when attention has been pleasantly occupied.
senses.whyCN: 这个名词在动词 amuse 后加 -ment：注意力被愉快占据后留下的状态。

senses.title: An entertaining activity or place
senses.definition: something organized to entertain people, such as a game, show, or park
senses.definitionCN: 为娱乐人们而组织的事物，如游戏、演出或公园
senses.example: The town fair offers amusements for every age.
senses.exampleCN: 镇上的集市为每个年龄的人提供消遣。
senses.why: The feeling can be packaged: a ride or a game is a machine for producing that pleasant state.
senses.whyCN: 这种感受可以被包装：一项游乐设施或游戏，就是生产那种愉快状态的机器。

senses.title: Light diversion from serious work
senses.definition: a light activity that gives relief from work or boredom
senses.definitionCN: 使人从工作或无聊中得到缓解的轻松活动
senses.example: He reads detective novels purely for amusement.
senses.exampleCN: 他读侦探小说纯粹为了消遣。
senses.why: Amusement can also be the small door out of a serious day, not a grand entertainment but relief.
senses.whyCN: amusement 也可以是从严肃一天里逃出的一扇小门，不是盛大娱乐，而是缓解。

intro.en: Amusement is the noun built on amuse, and it names both the feeling and the machinery that produces it.
intro.cn: amusement 是建立在 amuse 之上的名词，既命名感受，也命名制造感受的装置。

items.en: Amuser meant 'to occupy or divert the attention', the verb behind the noun.
items.cn: amuser 意为「占据或转移注意力」，是名词背后的动词。

items.en: The French suffix -ment turned the verb into a noun of state or result.
items.cn: 法语后缀 -ment 把动词变成表示状态或结果的名词。

items.en: English amusement is recorded from the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 英语 amusement 自十七世纪有记录。

items.en: The first sense is the pleasant state of being entertained.
items.cn: 第一个义项是被娱乐时的愉快状态。

items.en: The second sense moved from the feeling to the rides, games and parks that produce it.
items.cn: 第二个义项从感受移向产生感受的游乐设施、游戏与公园。

items.en: Amusement park fixed the public-place sense in the twentieth century.
items.cn: amusement park 在二十世纪固定了「公共场所」这一义项。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the amuse family; the near-meaning group gathers fun and entertainment nouns.
note.cn: 形近组收 amuse 词族；近义组收乐趣与娱乐类名词。

entries.definition: The verb meaning to entertain or make laugh.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「逗乐；娱乐」。

entries.definition: Funny and lightly entertaining.
entries.definitionCN: 指有趣、轻松逗笑的。

entries.definition: Confused or puzzled rather than entertained.
entries.definitionCN: 指困惑、茫然，而非被逗乐。

entries.definition: Organized activity that entertains an audience.
entries.definitionCN: 指娱乐观众的有组织活动。

entries.definition: Enjoyment and light pleasure.
entries.definitionCN: 指享受与轻松的快乐。

entries.definition: The pleasure taken in an activity.
entries.definitionCN: 指从活动中获得的愉悦。

entries.definition: Something that turns attention away pleasantly.
entries.definitionCN: 指愉快地转移注意力的事物。

normalIntro.en: These hooks move from the feeling in a face to the park that manufactures it.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从脸上的感受，移到制造这种感受的游乐园。

normal.en: Amusement is the -ment of amuse: the state left after the laugh.
normal.cn: amusement 是 amuse 加 -ment：笑声过后留下的状态。

normal.en: To my amusement means the laugh happened to me.
normal.cn: to my amusement 意为好笑发生在我身上。

normal.en: An amusement park is a factory for that state.
normal.cn: 游乐园就是生产这种状态的工厂。

normal.en: Amusement arcade puts the same word in a room full of machines.
normal.cn: amusement arcade 把同一个词放进一间装满机器的屋子。

normal.en: Pure amusement means no work is hiding behind it.
normal.cn: pure amusement 意为背后没有藏着工作。

abstract.en: Picture a child's face at the top of a turning carousel.
abstract.cn: 想象一个孩子在旋转木马最高处的脸。

abstract.en: Now picture the same smile drawn on a ticket booth.
abstract.cn: 再想象同样的微笑被画在售票亭上。

abstract.en: The face and the booth are the two senses of amusement.
abstract.cn: 那张脸与售票亭，就是 amusement 的两个义项。

examples.en: The children shouted with amusement at the puppet show.
examples.cn: 孩子们看木偶戏时乐得直叫。

examples.en: The seaside town has a small amusement park.
examples.cn: 这座海滨小镇有一座小游乐园。

examples.en: To my amusement, the cat slept in the box meant for the dog.
examples.cn: 令我好笑的是，猫睡进了给狗准备的箱子。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿缪兹门特」——阿，缪兹门特，一进门就乐，游乐园

root: 法语 amuser（占据注意力）+ 名词后缀 -ment，十七世纪进入英语；由「被娱乐的状态」扩展为「娱乐活动、游乐设施」。

sensesIntro.en: The senses run from the inner feeling, to the activity that produces it, to the light relief it gives.
sensesIntro.cn: 各义项从内心感受，到产生它的活动，再到它带来的轻松缓解。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a carousel turns and the laughter of the crowd rises with it.
core.cn: 核心意象：旋转木马转动，人群的笑声随之起伏。

branches.en: THE FEELING: the first sense is the inner pleasant state.
branches.cn: 感受线：第一个义项是内心的愉快状态。

branches.en: THE PARK: the second sense is the place or ride that produces it.
branches.cn: 游园线：第二个义项是产生这种状态的地方或设施。

branches.en: THE RELIEF: the third sense is the small door out of a serious day.
branches.cn: 缓解线：第三个义项是从严肃一天里逃出的小门。

branches.en: THE MACHINE: feeling and park are the product and the factory.
branches.cn: 机器线：感受与游乐园是产品与工厂。

branches.en: THE ESCAPE: laughter and relief both loosen a tight day.
branches.cn: 逃离线：笑声与缓解都让紧绷的一天松开。

intro.en: Amusement is the noun of the amuse family, and its list gathers the verb, its adjectives and its common frames.
intro.cn: amusement 是 amuse 词族的名词，条目收集动词、形容词与常用框架。

latinIntro.en: The word came through French, so no direct Latin entry is listed.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词经法语传来，因此不列直接拉丁条目。

items.exampleCN: 这个消息引起很大乐趣。

items.example: The amusement park opens at ten.
They met in an amusement arcade.
items.exampleCN: 他们在一家游戏厅见面。

items.meaning: in a way that I found funny
items.example: To my amusement, the dog answered the phone.
items.exampleCN: 令我好笑的是，狗接了电话。

definition_zh: 一（用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前）；每一（用于速率表达）
definition_en: the indefinite article used before a singular countable noun that begins with a vowel sound
core_image: 一个单独的东西被点到，前面挂着一枚小小的量词
scene: 桌上只剩一只苹果，孩子伸手去拿。She ate an apple before the bus came.
sceneCN: 这里 an 是「一」（第 1 个义项：用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前的不定冠词）；句意为她在公交车来之前吃了一个苹果。

pos.zh: 冠词：一（用于元音音素开头的单数可数名词前）

derivatives.zh: 同源变体，用于辅音音素开头的单数可数名词前
同源数词，义为「一」，an 即由它弱化而来

senses.title: The indefinite article before a vowel sound
senses.titleCN: 一（元音音素前的不定冠词）
senses.definition: used before a singular countable noun beginning with a vowel sound to mean one, not a particular one
senses.definitionCN: 用于以元音音素开头的单数可数名词前，表示「一个」，而非特指某一个
senses.example: She bought an orange and a pear.
senses.exampleCN: 她买了一个橙子和一个梨。
senses.why: Old English an meant 'one'; when the numeral weakened into an article, the n stayed before vowels because it made pronunciation easier.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 an 意为「一」；当这个数词弱化为冠词时，n 在元音前保留下来，因为这样发音更顺。

senses.title: Each, in rate expressions
senses.definition: used in phrases of rate or frequency, such as twice an hour, to mean per each
senses.definitionCN: 用于速率或频率短语，如 twice an hour，表示「每一」
senses.example: The bus leaves twice an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这路公交车每小时发两班。
senses.why: The old numeral 'one' still shows through: twice an hour means twice for one hour, one hour at a time.
senses.whyCN: 古老数词「一」仍透出来：twice an hour 意为每一小时两次，一次计一小时。

intro.en: An is the weakened form of the word for one, and its n survives only before vowel sounds.
intro.cn: an 是「一」这个词的弱化形式，它的 n 只在元音音素前保留。

items.en: The reconstructed form *ainaz meant 'one', the ancestor of English one and German ein.
items.cn: 重构形式 *ainaz 意为「一」，是英语 one 与德语 ein 的共同祖先。

items.en: Old English ān meant 'one' and worked both as a numeral and as a marker of a single thing.
items.cn: 古英语 ān 意为「一」，既作数词，也标记单个事物。

items.en: In unstressed use the long vowel shortened, giving the article forms an and a.
items.cn: 在非重读用法中，长元音缩短，产生了冠词形式 an 与 a。

items.en: The n is kept before a vowel sound and dropped before a consonant sound.
items.cn: n 在元音音素前保留，在辅音音素前脱落。

items.en: By the thirteenth century an before vowels was the settled form.
items.cn: 到十三世纪，元音前的 an 已成为固定形式。

items.en: Modern an also appears in rate phrases such as twice an hour.
items.cn: 现代 an 还出现在 twice an hour 这类速率短语中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers its form and source; the near-meaning group gathers other determiners.
note.cn: 形近组收它的形式与来源；近义组收其他限定词。

entries.definition: The same article before a consonant sound.
entries.definitionCN: 同一个冠词，用于辅音音素前。

entries.definition: The numeral from which the article weakened.
entries.definitionCN: 冠词由之弱化而来的数词。

entries.definition: The definite article, marking a particular thing.
entries.definitionCN: 定冠词，标记特定的事物。

entries.definition: An indefinite quantity, often plural or uncountable.
entries.definitionCN: 指不确定的数量，多用于复数或不可数。

entries.definition: One or some, without specifying which.
entries.definitionCN: 指某一个或一些，不指明是哪个。

entries.definition: For each, the preposition behind rate phrases.
entries.definitionCN: 指每一，是速率短语背后的介词。

normalIntro.en: These hooks reduce one to a small article and keep the n only where it is easy to say.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子把「一」缩成小冠词，只在好发音的地方留下 n。

normal.en: An is one worn down: the numeral became a small article.
normal.cn: an 就是被磨小的 one：数词变成了小冠词。

normal.en: Keep the n before a vowel, drop it before a consonant.
normal.cn: 元音前留住 n，辅音前丢掉它。

normal.en: An apple is one apple, not a particular apple.
normal.cn: an apple 是一个苹果，不是特定的那个苹果。

normal.en: Twice an hour means twice for each hour.
normal.cn: twice an hour 意为每一小时两次。

normal.en: Sound decides the form, not spelling: an hour, a university.
normal.cn: 决定形式的是读音而非拼写：an hour，a university。

abstract.en: Picture a single apple on a table with no label attached.
abstract.cn: 想象桌上一个苹果，没有贴任何标签。

abstract.en: Now picture the word one shrinking until only a small hook remains.
abstract.cn: 再想象 one 这个词缩小，直到只剩一个小钩。

abstract.en: That hook is an: one thing, not yet identified.
abstract.cn: 那个小钩就是 an：一样东西，尚未被指认。

examples.en: He waited an hour for the bus.
examples.cn: 他等公交车等了一小时。

examples.en: She is an artist, not a teacher.
examples.cn: 她是艺术家，不是老师。

examples.en: The nurse checks the patient twice an hour.
examples.cn: 护士每小时查看病人两次。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「安」——安上一个「一」，元音前就用 an

root: 古英语 ān（一），与 one 同源；非重读时弱化为冠词，元音音素前保留 n 作 an，辅音音素前脱落 n 作 a。

sensesIntro.en: The two senses are the weakened numeral: one unspecified thing, and one unit in a rate.
sensesIntro.cn: 两个义项都是弱化的数词：一个未被指明的个体，以及速率中的一个单位。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single object is pointed out, with a small hook attached in front of it.
core.cn: 核心意象：点出一个单独的东西，前面挂着一个小钩。

branches.en: THE ONE: the first sense marks a single countable thing.
branches.cn: 个体线：第一个义项标记一个可数的单个事物。

branches.en: THE UNIT: the second sense uses one as a unit of rate.
branches.cn: 单位线：第二个义项把「一」用作速率的单位。

branches.en: THE HOOK: both senses hang on the old numeral one.
branches.cn: 挂钩线：两个义项都挂在古老数词 one 上。

branches.en: THE UNKNOWN: the article never identifies which one.
branches.cn: 未知线：这个冠词从不指认是哪一个。

branches.en: THE EACH: rate phrases turn one into per.
branches.cn: 每一线：速率短语把「一」变成「每一」。

intro.en: An is a function word rather than a derived form, so its list gathers its variant, its source and its common frames.
intro.cn: an 是功能词而非派生形式，条目收集它的变体、来源与常用框架。

latinIntro.en: The word is native English, so the Latin entry list is empty.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词属于本土英语，因此拉丁条目为空。

items.example: The bell rings twice an hour.
